headline: Cool Planet Technologies officially opens membrane CO2 capture demonstration plant at Holcim's Höver cement works
summary: Cool Planet Technologies held the official opening of its membrane-based CO2 capture demonstration plant at Holcim Germany's Höver cement works in Lower Saxony; the multilayer-polymer-membrane, end-of-pipe unit is sized to capture ~10,000 t/yr of CO2, with the technology aimed at eventually capturing ~90% of the plant's ~500,000 t/yr emissions.
co2crc_note: Retrofittable membrane capture on hard-to-abate cement flue gas is a lower-cost capture pathway of direct interest to CO2CRC's capture-technology programme.
extractor_note: Radar (7 Sep, one day outside the 8-9 Sep window). Page-fetch to carbonherald.com blocked by egress proxy; date and details confirmed via corroborating trade coverage (CemNet, Global Cement). Underlying plant was commissioned 21 Aug 2026; this is the official opening event.

headline: Peak Cluster requests Wirral Council land access for surveys on its £5bn CO2 pipeline network
summary: The Peak Cluster project formally asked Wirral Council for access to council-owned land to run survey works for its proposed £5bn CCS pipeline network, which would gather CO2 from Derbyshire and Staffordshire cement and lime plants and route it across the Wirral for permanent offshore storage beneath the Irish Sea; the request goes to the council's Policy and Resource Committee amid local and Chester Zoo concerns.
co2crc_note: Illustrates the social-licence and land-access friction of onshore CO2 pipeline routing, relevant to Australian onshore transport planning.
extractor_note: Radar (7 Sep, one day outside window). £5bn is the stated project-cost scale of the pipeline network, not a new commitment; commitment_status 'announced'. Page-fetch blocked by egress proxy; corroborated by Wirral Today and Chester Standard.

headline: Africa eyes depleted oil and gas reservoirs for carbon storage
summary: A World Oil feature, timed to the African Energy Week build-up, surveys how African producers are looking to repurpose depleted oil and gas reservoirs and existing infrastructure as CO2 storage hubs to lower emissions from hydrocarbon production and extend asset life; South Africa (Council for Geoscience/Sasol, the Leandra saline-formation pilot) and Nigeria's emerging carbon-market architecture feature.
co2crc_note: Depleted-reservoir storage is CO2CRC's core competency (Otway); Africa emerging as a new storage frontier is a watch item for partnerships and competition.
extractor_note: Radar (7 Sep, one day outside window). Thematic feature rather than a discrete new commitment; commitment_status 'na'.
